svg.title: Risk matrix of WP-C-07
svg.desc: Two four-by-four matrices of likelihood against impact. Left, every threat scenario before treatment; right, after the cybersecurity requirements with the designed safety architecture. Cells are shaded low, medium or high.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 6-1 Threat scenarios on the likelihood x impact matrix, before and after treatment

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 scenarios. Before: 11 high, 9 medium, 0 low. After: 0 high, 2 medium, 18 low. The safety architecture moves a scenario left, the requirements move it down

svg.text: Chips are scenario numbers: 01 is TS-01. Risk = likelihood x impact; low is tolerable, medium only as an accepted residual, high never (§1.3).
